_meta.description: Permanent failure database: one structured entry per killed strategy/cell. Companion to RESEARCH_LOG prose; the log holds the full record, this holds the queryable skeleton. Lesson tags are a controlled vocabulary: spread-eaten | windfall-year | trend-bleed | regime-non-transfer | no-edge | min-N-starvation | stale-mechanism | measurement-uninformative.
_meta.convention: numeric_reason quotes the kill-deciding numbers; log_ref is the adjudicating commit where known

entries.hypothesis: RSI crossover mean-reversion entries carry a candle-scale edge
entries.numeric_reason: zero-spread edge ~$8/trade vs ~$9/trade spread cost at 8-12p stops (0.9 lots @ $80 risk)
entries.lesson: Fails whenever spread is ~10%+ of typical stop distance; candle-scale stops on this account die to spread regardless of signal quality

entries.hypothesis: MACD(12,26,9) + RSI 40-60 band filters produce tradeable entries
entries.numeric_reason: WR 15-23% vs ~28.6% breakeven at 2.5R
entries.lesson: Indicator-combination filters with no structural anchor produced WR far below breakeven everywhere tested

entries.hypothesis: London-open range breakout momentum is tradeable
entries.numeric_reason: WR 7-22% across all variants vs 28.6% breakeven
entries.lesson: Session-boundary momentum had no edge in any variant; later session-FADE also failed (see session_fade) -- session boundaries are not structural levels on these pairs

entries.hypothesis: Order-block retests are tradeable supply/demand levels
entries.numeric_reason: intraday +$859/6yr but ZERO pair-year-direction cells pass min-N(10); scalp 26.9% WR spread-dominated; single-pending-block starvation (avg pending 108.6 -> 788.2 candles when loosened)
entries.lesson: Single-pending-slot architectures starve themselves; loosening thresholds paradoxically reduced frequency by lengthening pending occupancy

entries.hypothesis: MA-touch pullback entries in trends
entries.numeric_reason: insufficient standalone record; design evolved into trend-origin (origin-anchored SL replaced MA anchor)
entries.lesson: MA-anchored stops are not structural; origin-anchored replacement (trend-origin) is the surviving lineage

entries.hypothesis: 61.8% fib-level bounces (with/without volume-profile gating) are tradeable
entries.numeric_reason: USD_JPY full window negative; short side structurally worse (WR gap, not mechanical)
entries.lesson: Ratio-derived levels without structural anchoring showed no edge; closed the retracement-confluence behavior slot

entries.hypothesis: Fading confirmed-fractal-pair range boundaries mean-reverts
entries.numeric_reason: 39.8% WR vs 42.8% breakeven, net -$526 in the best mapped range territory
entries.lesson: Fractal-confirmed boundaries lag: by confirmation the turning zone has moved; boundary definitions must refresh within the regime's own timescale

entries.hypothesis: Rolling 20-day extremes fix v1's stale boundaries
entries.numeric_reason: USD_JPY 2022Q2-Q4: -$1,004 over 40 trades (~25% WR) -- deep bleed, not edge-to-zero; crown jewel passed (+$148-$476)
entries.lesson: Fixing range-period mechanics does not fix trend-period exposure; fractal non-trend gates pass during consolidation pauses, exactly when fades lose

entries.hypothesis: Failed-breakout confirmation at fractal levels self-gates in trends
entries.numeric_reason: USD_JPY 2021Q2-2022Q1 (a MAPPED RANGING stretch): -$559/68 trades, 20.6% WR vs 22.9% BE; crown jewel passed +$1,378
entries.lesson: Range CHARACTER matters: rotational ranges reward sweep-fades, stair-step drifting ranges resolve sweeps trendward; 'ranging' by ER is not one regime

entries.hypothesis: Operator re-entry under single-stretch kill-test; self-gating thesis at full scale
entries.numeric_reason: criterion 2: 1/3 secondaries; criterion 3: USD_JPY 2022Q2-Q4 8.9% WR -$2,872/56; combined -$8,421
entries.lesson: Self-gating REFUTED at scale: sweeps confirm on shallow pullbacks and resolve trendward; failure-confirmation entries do not go quiet in trends, they get trapped by them

entries.hypothesis: Failed Asian-range breakouts fade like failed fractal sweeps
entries.numeric_reason: 20.3% WR vs 29.7% BE, -$1,858/64 trades; ~4 qualifying trades/month after spread floor
entries.lesson: The failed-move premise does not transfer from structural (fractal) levels to session boundaries: session breaks that pull back re-break; same costume, different body

entries.hypothesis: Failed excursions outside the volume-profile value area revert to POC
entries.numeric_reason: 25.7% WR vs 29.9% BE, -$856/74 trades in the best mapped range
entries.lesson: Statistical boundaries (VA edges) recenter continuously and mark internal drift, not structure; failed-excursion confirmation is weaker at statistical than structural levels

entries.hypothesis: An explicit ER(20)<0.20 gate fixes the sweep chassis's trend exposure (LAST design in the MR line)
entries.numeric_reason: criteria 1-2 PASSED (first ever); trend leaks ran 0-12% WR: USD_JPY 22Q2-Q4 -$1,266/26, USD_CAD 2026 0-for-18
entries.lesson: Trailing regime measures open during trend-consolidation pauses -- exactly when sweep confirmations fire; a lagging gate cannot fix a coincidence-timed exposure. Closed the entire MR line (6 designs)

entries.hypothesis: Trend-origin as-designed transfers to the low-vol benchmark major
entries.lesson: One good year (2022 dollar surge), rest of window gives it back

entries.hypothesis: Trend-origin transfers to a no-USD-leg European cross
entries.numeric_reason: -$7,762/1,370; 1/6 years; long side negative every year
entries.lesson: No dominant secular driver = nothing to capture; first no-USD/JPY-leg evidence

entries.hypothesis: Trend-origin transfers to a commodity cross (no USD leg)
entries.numeric_reason: -$12,474/1,342; 1/6 years; BOTH directions negative
entries.lesson: Cross-commodity relative value has no persistent secular driver for this design

entries.hypothesis: Restoring the USD leg (safe-haven franc) restores the edge
entries.lesson: Best record of the line still windfall-shaped; USD leg buys one good year, not persistence

entries.hypothesis: Trend-origin transfers to the commodity dollar
entries.lesson: Different windfall year (2021, not 2022) than sibling pairs -- single-year noise, not weak common edge

entries.hypothesis: AUD_USD's shape replicates on its closest sibling
entries.numeric_reason: -$12,758/1,320; 1/6 years; long negative EVERY year
entries.lesson: Sibling non-replication (AUD peaked 2021, NZD 2022) confirms noise-around-zero

entries.hypothesis: Trend capture exists at the volatility floor (SNB-shadowed cross)
entries.lesson: Best prop SHAPE on the line, no edge -- shape and edge are uncorrelated

entries.hypothesis: The narrowed yen-specific hypothesis: AUD_JPY shows USD_JPY-like short-yen persistence
entries.numeric_reason: +$43/1,339 (flat); 2/6 years; long side 2025-dominated (ex-2025 +$2,685/5yr)
entries.lesson: Yen-cross persistence did NOT transfer: the trend-origin edge is specific to USD_JPY itself, closing the hypothesis at maximum narrowness

entries.hypothesis: Nested FVG (M5 entry / 4H anchor) is tradeable on GBP_USD+USD_JPY
entries.numeric_reason: USD_JPY +$2,491/497 but the single 2023-SHORT cell = +$2,790 > total net (ex-cell -$299); GBP_USD -$3,104 outright
entries.lesson: Single year x direction CELL dependency; also the reference case for quick-checks sampling the carrying year (2023 was both the check year and the edge)

entries.hypothesis: Donchian midpoint-stop works at M5
entries.numeric_reason: median stop 14.2p (<15 kill); expectancy -$4.75/trade; -$14,213/2,991 in one year
entries.lesson: At M5 the midpoint stop is ~14p; 1.5p spread >10% of stop -- the quantified floor of the family gradient

entries.hypothesis: Donchian midpoint-stop works at M15
entries.numeric_reason: expectancy -$0.47/trade over 1,008 trades (median stop 26.3p fine)
entries.lesson: The gradient's middle point: family edge crosses zero between M15 and M30 -- M30 (scalp30) sits just above its cost floor

entries.hypothesis: Trend-origin as-designed works at H1
entries.lesson: Long side positive every year at H1 too, but short bleed (-$7,695) is fatal at this rung; short bleed scales inversely with timeframe

entries.hypothesis: The validated spread chassis works with H4-granularity estimation
entries.numeric_reason: -$1,101/147; PRE24 +$238 / POST24 -$1,340 (daily estimation of the same family: POST24 POSITIVE)
entries.lesson: Estimation window is load-bearing in CALENDAR time: 90 H4 bars = 15 days of memory chases post-break noise where 90 daily bars ride through it

entries.hypothesis: Same H4-estimation chassis on NZD/CAD
entries.numeric_reason: expectancy -$3.85/trade (29 trades, -$112); half-life stable (74h vs 1,167h threshold)
entries.lesson: Half-life stability alone does not make a tradeable H4 spread; see cell 6's calendar-memory lesson

entries.hypothesis: Donchian swing (D/H4) on USD_CAD is an independently validated pair
entries.numeric_reason: retired on +$293/225 (3 min-N fails, 91%/89% top-5 concentration, 1.01x/6yr); corrected record SIGN-FLIPPED to -$4,760/376 (D-granularity warm-up bug hid ~5 months/year)
entries.lesson: Thin records that pass on marginal numbers can be artifacts of the harness itself; the corrected record was decisively negative. Also: 'validated independently' claims must survive re-examination under current standards

entries.hypothesis: Session-anchored VWAP (00:00 UTC hard reset, volume-weighted sigma bands) fixes v1's staleness and adds the volume dimension the six dead MR designs lacked
entries.numeric_reason: 17.4% WR vs ~33% breakeven, net -$19,322/178 (USD_CAD 22Q3-23Q3); ALL five quarters negative incl. ranging 2023; long and short both 17.4%
entries.lesson: A close beyond 2 sigma of a session-anchored volume-weighted distribution marks intraday momentum, not exhaustion -- VWAP drags toward the move, so band breaches select for moves strong enough to beat their own anchor. Seventh MR death: the M30-scale reversion premium does not exist on this account net of costs; closure reinforced. Spec lesson: R:R floors do not bound absolute stop distance (one 0.1-pip-stop trade lost $1,895)

entries.hypothesis: Retail position-book extremes (70/30, 80/20) precede reversals
entries.numeric_reason: aggregate long% spans 52.7-64.9 over 11,382 pair-days; registered extremes occur ZERO times in 5.5 years
entries.lesson: Stock measures (all open positions) are variance-damped; the position book barely moved through a 30-yen round trip. Measure construction matters more than the hypothesis

entries.hypothesis: The NY-close/Sydney-open liquidity trough (17:00-19:00 ET) produces a structural, mechanism-based price dislocation distinct from price-action mean reversion
entries.kill_stage: PARTIAL REJECT at overshoot-vs-real-cost gate -- pre-declared kill condition (cost dominates on ALL three pairs, or events too rare) NOT met; rejected on portfolio-concentration grounds by operator decision, not mechanism failure
entries.numeric_reason: mechanism CONFIRMED cross-pair (window tick volume 0.30-0.64x flanking hours, per-print volatility amplified 1.6-2.3x, DST spot-checked clean on 4 dates); tradeable residual after REAL spread (OANDA MBA candles): rev/cost across N=2/3/4 thresholds AUD_USD 0.97-1.04 and NZD_USD 0.89-0.97 (cost-dominated), USD_JPY 1.11-1.55 but UPPER-BOUND (reversion measured from unreachable window extreme; only 56% of events clear cost, mean carried by fat right tail); quoted spread spikes 1.3-1.6p -> 8-10p at the 17:00 rollover
entries.lesson: Execution cost is worst exactly when the liquidity edge occurs -- the rollover spread spike consumes the overshoot on 2 of 3 pairs and thins the third. Same failure signature as the pair-expansion (trend-origin transfer) line: mechanism generalizes cross-pair, tradeable payoff is USD_JPY-only, which duplicates existing ~85% fleet USD_JPY concentration instead of adding an uncorrelated bet. NOT a flat kill -- reopen bar: genuinely cross-pair tradeable residual after real spread cost, with reversion measured from an EXECUTABLE entry (not the window extreme), clearing cost on AUD_USD or NZD_USD, not just USD_JPY.
